L1 `import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'`: useState (which seeded customPrimary/customAccent from localStorage) is no longer needed — those values are read from the store's live `custom` theme entry — so the import becomes useCallback/useMemo/useSyncExternalStore (used by the native theme store + shims). ReactNode (typing the modeIcons map) is replaced by a Record<string,string> glyph map, so it is dropped.

L2 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'`: react-i18next is unavailable in native parity; replaced by a local useNativeTranslationFallback() t() shim returning the English fallback verbatim while preserving every key (theme.theme/mode/displayMode/accentColor/custom/primary/accent).

L3 `import { CheckCircle, Sun, Moon, Monitor, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react'`: lucide-react is DOM/SVG-only; the glyphs become decorative Unicode in AppText (importantForAccessibility="no"): Moon ☾ U+263E, Sun ☀ U+2600, Monitor ▢ U+25A2, Sparkles ✦ U+2726, CheckCircle ✓ U+2713 (modeGlyphs map + CHECK_GLYPH). Same approach as the Lightbox/DataTableBulkBar ports.
L4 `import { Button } from './Button'`: preserved — reuses the already-ported native ./Button (Pressable-based). Used as variant="ghost" size="auto" with tile chrome via the native `style` prop.

L5 `import { Input } from './Input'`: not ported to native and only used as `type="color"`; core RN has no colour picker, so each editor renders a read-only colour swatch + live hex (the coloured square a browser draws for <input type=color>). Documented; the interactive onChange path is dropped.

L6 `import { useTheme, type ThemeId, type ModeId } from './ThemeProvider'`: ThemeProvider is NOT yet ported. ThemeId/ModeId/ColorTheme/ModeTheme types + the themes/modes data tables are reproduced VERBATIM here, and a useSyncExternalStore-backed in-process store provides useTheme() (themeId/modeId/setTheme/setMode/setCustomColors/themes/modes). The web's localStorage seeding, backend /settings persistence, broadcast/subscribe cross-tab sync, window.matchMedia auto-mode and document CSS-var application are all browser-only and dropped — store is in-memory only.
